bullets: Fix #getforcurrentview: map DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() to Microsoft.Graphics.Display.DisplayInformation.CreateForWindowId(windowId) (keeps orientation/DPI), not just the DPI shortcut, so orientation/display-info migrations don't degrade to a broken try/catch.

Soften the section's 'None of the GetForCurrentView() patterns work' overstatement to 'the entry point is gone — use a window-scoped factory', and add a windowId+CurrentOrientation code snippet with the DispatcherQueue/caching note.
